{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows negative bias (e.g., -0.25 or 0.00) and model overestimates.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent history shows mean reversion toward lower prices.",
    "If model spikes upward after a low, apply a lag correction: subtract 0.5-1.0 from the peak forecast.",
    "When sentiment includes a positive signal (e.g., 0.50), increase forecast by 3-5% to account for bullish momentum.",
    "For 30-day forecasts, apply a smoothing filter: average last 3 true outcomes to reduce volatility bias.",
    "If true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by >10%, reduce forecast by 15% for next period to avoid overconfidence.",
    "For long-term (30d) forecasts, apply a 10% downward bias if sentiment is neutral or negative over 5+ days."
  ]
}
